fields.summary_ko.0: Applied Materials, Inc. (AMAT) declined 24.30% over the past month but is up 70.26% on an annual basis, trading at $387.59 on October 26 with a market cap of $307.59B.
fields.summary_ko.1: AMAT has been affected by rotation out of AI-related stocks following reassessment of AI investment economics, and the stock is held in the portfolios of 137 large hedge funds in the semiconductor equipment industry.
